items.title: Jackie McLean — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: INTERVIEWER: Bob Bunyan’s a name that comes up, I guess, in A. B.’s text [A. B. Spellman].

ctx.x: A guy named Bob Bunyan, a piano player that lived in Harlem. So I took Richard to Bob, and Bob started teaching him.
Bob Bunyan’s a name that comes up, I guess, in A. B.’s text [A. B. Spellman]. You probably mentioned him. Tell us about him and what happened to him.
I don’t know what happened to Bob. I just knew that he was much older than me. He was about Bud’s age and played good.
